articles.title: No GPS tracker for Arnold, can work out for teams
articles.summary: Former Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold does not need to wear a GPS tracker as a condition of his release, a Florida judge ruled Friday, allowing him to continue to work out with NFL teams in an effort to get re-signed after being cut.

articles.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
